uzo.purpose: Chooses one of a few options that all stay visible: payment method, shipping speed, yes/no/maybe.

instead.kialo: Six or more options, or an unknown number, belong in a list that opens on demand, because a group that long is no longer read; Fundamento covers it with elektilo.
A yes or no is a check mark, because a box that is ticked or not says it with one control where two options would ask twice; Fundamento covers it with markobutono.
Several options at once are the plurelektilo's, because a radio group holds exactly one answer; it shows the chosen as a count or as tags (Spec 025 ③ closes the alternative multi).

boundary.kialo: A choice of one is no choice, because a person cannot pick between options that are not there; one option is a checkbox or a text.
A radio group without a visible label shows options without the question, because the circles say which answer is chosen and only the label says to what.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A choice without a form has no sender, because its answer is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may ask for one of a few answers before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need it (shipping speed).

containers.name: filter-bar
containers.kialo: A filter of a few values stays visible above the list it narrows, because a person sees at once which filter holds.

with.kialo: A choice stands among the fields of a form, one below the other, because a person reads a form top down and answers it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because choosing an option does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field.

never.kialo: A radio group stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the options could not be reached on their own.
